findings.description: Critical: The executable work-package DAG contradicts tasks.md: wp-prioritize and wp-integration can start without wp-producers, even though candidate ranking depends on all three producer implementations and integration explicitly exercises and mirrors them.
findings.resolution: Add wp-producers to wp-prioritize.depends_on (matching task 2.1) and to wp-integration.depends_on, or make the integration dependency transitive through wp-prioritize; then rerun DAG and overlap validation.

findings.description: Nit: wp-producers may update canonical bug-scrub and improve-harness skill documentation, but its write scope omits the corresponding skills/tests/bug-scrub and skills/tests/improve-harness documentation-contract suites.
findings.resolution: Add both canonical skill-test directories to wp-producers.write_allow so documentation assertions can be updated without scope violations.

findings.description: The plan correctly defines full-batch validation, atomic replacement, stable ordering, collision handling, and transaction-safe existing-roadmap intake as explicit executable contracts.
findings.resolution: Preserve these boundaries during implementation and validation.
